title: Skama Scam Blocker
features:
Blocks skamas aka Morreira service.
The skama service is a bad service that allows users to make scripts that allow the user to join your game and steal your items in economic related games.
They use three methods to scam you such as executing a 2nd loadstring, freeze scam, and no gui.

This script hopes to prevent you from being a victim by blocking that fishy script.
script:
--[[
Helps block the skama scam that allows the stealer to join your game and steal your shit -- brainrots and other economic goods

what they can steal in these games
targets steal a brainrot but I'm pretty sure there are other games they may target

they have three methods to steal from you
Freeze method -- freezes your game
No Gui -- Appears to be a script that does nothing but actually does something
Loadstring -- disguise the stealer as another script by adding another script/loadstring

Put in your autoexc folder to make life easier ig
--]]
loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jodta/my-scripts/refs/heads/main/skama-scam-blocker.lua"))()
